title: Build a Travel Planner Workflow
description: Use AI to plan a trip — itinerary, logistics, packing list, and contingency plans — and evaluate where AI shines vs falls short.
steps: Choose a real upcoming trip or a hypothetical destination
Use Perplexity: "Top 10 things to do in [destination] for [type of traveler] in [season]"
Use Claude: "Build me a day-by-day itinerary for 5 days in [destination] including: morning/afternoon/evening slots, transit notes, and meal options per day"
Ask: "What are the most common mistakes tourists make in [destination]?"
Ask: "Generate a packing list for [destination] in [season] for a [duration] trip"
expectedOutput: A complete trip plan with itinerary, packing list, and local tips, ready to use or refine.
bonusChallenges: Ask AI to build a contingency plan: "If it rains on day 2, what are indoor alternatives?"
Compare Perplexity and ChatGPT recommendations for the same destination
